familyTheme: Workbook-first reporting tasks that test spreadsheet enrichment and pivot-table construction across income analysis, clinic operations, retail margin reporting, and training grant planning.

derivedTasks.title: Similar - Income Band Review Workbook
derivedTasks.goal: Enrich regional income rows with prefixes, quartiles, and payroll, then build four pivot tables over the workbook.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task exercises spreadsheet editing, calculated columns, workbook authoring, and pivot-table configuration close to the source task.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer 1 - Clinic Demand Review Workbook
derivedTasks.goal: Convert clinic demand rows into a review workbook with pressure metrics and pivot summaries by zone and pressure band.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task transfers the same spreadsheet manipulation skill into an operational capacity-planning scenario.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer 2 - Retail Margin Pack Workbook
derivedTasks.goal: Build a retail workbook with gross and net revenue calculations plus pivot summaries by territory, format, and return band.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task tests spreadsheet formulas and pivot-table authoring in a commerce reporting setting.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer 3 - Training Grant Dashboard Workbook
derivedTasks.goal: Build a training grant workbook with completion and spend calculations plus pivot summaries by region, track, and completion band.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task moves the same XLSX workflow into program planning and grant reporting.
